## Smooth top bar on every tab

- **Home:** the **Play Now** title now fades in gradually as you scroll down (and out as you go back to the top), following your finger, instead of appearing all at once.
- **All tabs (Home, Library, Search, Settings):** the bar uses the iOS 26 soft scroll-edge effect, a progressive blur that grows as content slides under it, instead of a bar background that switches on. The titles on Library and Settings stay as they were.
